title: Independent Held-Out Qualification of the Bounded Stiffness-Aware Richards Temporal Indicator
qualified: Exact manufactured constant-linear regression reproduces the fixed analytic factor-2 combined bound without formula drift.
The fixed F-SI24 indicator has no negative transfer against the frozen finite same-endpoint N512 comparator in any of 16 disjoint held-out nonlinear B1.10 cases.
The normal candidate cost remains one unchanged principal nonlinear Richards solve plus one additional tridiagonal defect solve and O(N) accepted-state operator evaluation.
The indicator remains observer-only and leaves hard mass conservation, candidate state and accepted fluxes unchanged.
A production implementation may proceed only by exposing accepted-state operator evaluation through the soil-water solver interface.
not_qualified: A general nonlinear true-error upper bound.
A scientific application tolerance or universal temporal acceptance threshold.

reconciliation.F_VQ28: Remains negative for direct translation of raw step-doubling/retry behavior into the existing transaction topology. F-VQ30 does not overturn that result because the candidate normal path contains no deep refinement ladder and no second nonlinear companion trajectory.
reconciliation.F_VQ29: Remains fail-closed because finite refinement could not support a true error-bound derivation. F-VQ30 does not promote N512 to truth and does not derive q_cap, Nmin, a geometric tail multiplier or scientific tolerance.
reconciliation.F_SI23: Raw derivative-difference observer mechanics remain useful but strongly conservative. The F-SI24 stiffness-aware transport reduces that conservatism while preserving bounded cost.

next_action: Return ownership to F-SI25 for the smallest production seam that exposes solver-owned accepted-state operator evaluation and the fixed bounded stiffness-aware indicator without exposing HeadCalc internals, without changing principal backward-Euler state or mass semantics, and without selecting a temporal tolerance. After that, use F-MR18/F-KT10 for composition and F-VQ31 for independent production/scientific qualification before resuming the existing F-GC02 branch.
